Before you buy or sell

Card condition guide

A quick guide to the Guild’s five condition grades. Ask the staff if you’re unsure how a card should be graded.

NM

Near Mint

Minimal or no wear. Surfaces, corners, and edges are close to fresh out of the pack, with only minimal handling.

LP

Lightly Played

Slight border or corner wear, or minor scratches. No major defects. Foils may show slight fading or wear.

MP

Moderately Played

Visible, moderate wear. May include border or corner wear, scratches, creases, fading, light dirt, or water damage.

HP

Heavily Played

Heavy wear, including significant creasing, folding, water damage, whitening, worn borders, or tearing.

D

Damaged

Major bends, tears, creases, writing, inking, or severe wear. A card may be unsuitable for tournament play even in a sleeve.
